note: UBSan array-bounds at lchId[num_items-1] (a write) with num_items=17 into a 16-element array; fix adds num_items < MAX_EDCH_DDIS+1 bounds check on the index. The listed site dissect_per_sequence is only a generic caller in the stack, not the crash or defect location.

Fix adds SetImageBackgroundColor to initialise the property_image pixel data before FxGetSymbol/InterpolatePixelInfo reads it; without it the pixel is uninitialised and MSan fires in FxEvaluateSubexpression. Site 2 (AcquireAlignedMemory) is a generic allocator, unrelated to the missing init.

SEGV at address 0x8 (NULL+8, ob_type offset) in Py_TYPE via _PyCode_ConstantKey is a NULL deref (476). The fix in symtable.c:inline_comprehension moves the __class__-in-class-scope check outside the !existing guard so it applies when the name already exists, preventing the malformed code object that yields the NULL pointer. Neither listed site is the crash location or the fix location.

The fix adds an 'id > 0' guard in read_xref so that a negative object ID (e.g. -1) no longer triggers removeObject, which would erase the current map node and invalidate the live range-for iterator, causing the subsequent read to hit freed memory. Site 2 is just the C++ runtime operator delete invoked during the erase.
Fix adds tvb_ensure_bytes_exist to validate reported_len-3 against actual TVB size before passing it to rlp_fcs_compute, preventing the 1-byte OOB read past the 1MB buffer.

The old overflow check only bounded the sum against SIZE_MAX, but the size is later used in a 32-bit context (av_grow_packet), so values between INT_MAX and SIZE_MAX truncated to a small allocation; the fix caps the sum at INT_MAX, preventing the undersized buffer that leads to the OOB write in bytestream2_get_buffer.

The fix adds a bounds check (ntbytes > destsize) in blosc_c before calling _sw32 to write a 4-byte run-length value; without it, dest has already advanced past the 4126-byte buffer, so the write at dest-4 overflows. The missing check lives in blosc_c, not in the _sw32 helper where the crash manifests.

MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value created by a free in cil_tree_node_destroy; the fix in cil_resolve_ast adds a missing cil_tree_children_destroy call for disabled optionals when pass<=CALL1, preventing the parent from retaining a dangling pointer to the freed child. Site 2 (the free) is a legitimate operation; the defect is the absent cleanup in cil_resolve_ast.

The ethnl_pause_set_policy array was sized ETHTOOL_A_PAUSE_TX+1, so an attribute type up to ETHTOOL_A_PAUSE_STATS_SRC indexed out of bounds in pause_parse_request; the fix resizes the array and adds NLA_REJECT for the uncovered attribute, stopping the OOB read.

The fix adds a payload-size check (isDataValid) in TcpLayer before constructing a ModbusLayer, so the header getters (getFunctionCode etc.) are never invoked on a buffer shorter than modbus_header, preventing the OOB read at site 1.

Dataset::IsValid iterates TLVs without rejecting extended-format TLVs; an extended TLV's 2-byte length field makes GetNext/IsValid compute a wrong span, so IsValidUtf8String reads past the stack buffer. The fix adds !cur->IsExtended() to reject such TLVs before validation.
The guard at line 645 checked size+1 < remain (2 bytes) but the code reads sync[size+2] (3 bytes); the fix tightens the bound to size+3 < remain, preventing the OOB read of the 5000-byte sync buffer.

The fix flips #if 0 to #if 1, enabling the channelIndex >= numChannels guard in alac_decode that stops decoding once all configured channels are done, preventing the OOB write in copyPredictorTo24 when the bitstream carries more channel data than the config declares.

The fix checks the return value of ddsi_type_ref_proxy (previously ignored); on failure the type pointer can be in an invalid state, so ddsi_type_add_typeobj dereferences a NULL internal field and SEGVs on a WRITE to a near-zero address.

ReadMATImage destroys the image (DestroyImage→RelinquishMagickMemory) then calls CloseBlob on the same freed image; the mat.c fix adds image2!=image to skip that call. The blob.c NULL check is a secondary guard that does not address the freed-image read itself.

The fix is in linux-user/elfload.c (ELF program-header address computation), a subsystem entirely unrelated to the e1000e NIC packet-buffer UAF; it cannot prevent this crash. Site 2 (net_rx_pkt_iovec_realloc) is the likely origin of the dangling iovec pointer.

The fix clamps the 'excess' length in readwrite_data so that k->str+excess cannot run past the end of the receive buffer; without that check the oversized excess is passed to rtsp_rtp_readwrite whose memcpy reads 15022 bytes past the 16401-byte heap region.

The report is a bare ABRT in LLVMFuzzerInitialize with 'AddressSanitizer can not provide additional info', so no memory-error class (read/write/UAF/etc.) can be assigned. The fix deletes netops.c/h and its includes, but the diff is truncated and neither listed site (splitmix64, set_data) appears in the crash trace or the visible hunks, so the source weakness and causal link are not determinable.

The old check (offset+sz)>md->bytes can be bypassed when offset+sz wraps around (integer overflow), leaving left=sz and causing memcpy to read before the buffer. The fix adds offset>md->bytes to catch this before the addition.
The fix adds ((end - frag) < 2) to the while-loop guard in decode_extended_fragments, preventing frag[0]/frag[1] reads when fewer than 2 bytes remain; the OOB 1-byte READ at line 879 is the crash.

The fix properly decodes the resource name length as little-endian and validates read results in _parse_resource_directory; without this, a malformed PE resource entry leads to a name pointer being freed twice when the resources list is purged, crashing at the free in _free_resources (site 1).

processDelayedCallbacks frees the secure channel (leaving the session's pointer dangling), then invokes removeSessionCallback which calls UA_Session_detachFromSecureChannel on the freed channel. The fix moves the detach into removeSession so the session is detached before the channel is freed.

The fix moves xmlFree(guess) from before the if/else to after it, so guess is still valid when passed to htmlParseErr→__xmlRaiseError→vsnprintf. The premature free at site 1 is the defect; the UAF READ in vsnprintf at site 2 is the crash.

UBSan flags an invalid C-style downcast of a DOMTextImpl to DOMElement at line 304; the fix replaces the unchecked cast with dynamic_cast (which returns NULL for the wrong type), so the while loop is skipped and the UB is avoided. Site 1 (line 305) is just the subsequent while-loop condition, not the cast itself.

Fix adds a bounds check (bx >= avctx->width) in decompress_p before the loop that calls decode_run_p, preventing the out-of-bounds write into the frame buffer. The crash is a 4-byte heap-buffer-overflow WRITE at decode_run_p.

strtol was called on a pointer into the fuzzer input that was not null-terminated within the allocation; the fix copies the token into a bounded, null-terminated buffer before calling strtoll, preventing the 2-byte OOB read. Site 2 (atof call) is a secondary repair using the same bounded buffer.
Fix adds i<=word.size() bounds check on the index before word[i-1]/word[i-2] access in compound_check; the 1-byte OOB READ at line 1874 is in the same function/loop where the unchecked index is used.

Fix adds a return after delete poFeature in TranslateINSERTCore, preventing the dangling OGRFeature pointer from being stored and later used; the UBSan crash is an invalid-vptr member call on that freed object in GetNextUnfilteredFeature.

The fuzzer harness struct st was never zeroed before ndr_pull, so a [size_is]/[ref] field held a garbage pointer/size that made all_zero read past the dynamic stack buffer; the fix adds memset(st,'\0',sizeof(st)) to initialise it.

The crash is a MemorySanitizer use-of-uninitialized-value in the SkJumper CPU rasterization pipeline (unpremul_k), but the visible fix diff is entirely about GPU MSAA sample-count API changes (GrCaps, GrContext, GrRenderTarget) in a completely different subsystem; no change in the diff addresses the missing initialization that causes the uninitialized read.

UBSan reports index 6 out of bounds for a 5-element EdgebreakerTopologyBitPattern array in DecodeSymbol; the fix validates the decoded symbol index before using it to index the table, preventing the OOB read.
win was a fixed-size stack buffer (RLC_BN_BITS) but l was set to RLC_BN_BITS+1, causing a 1-byte OOB write in bn_rec_slw; the fix sizes both the buffer and l to bn_bits(b).

The fix adds validation rejecting policy values that combine SCTP_PR_SCTP_ALL with SCTP_PR_SCTP_MASK bits, preventing an out-of-bounds slab read in sctp_getsockopt_pr_streamstatus. Site 1 (ext4 free_rb_tree_fname) is unrelated to the SCTP crash.

The fix adds a bounds check (hash >= cd->hash_size) before using hash as an index into cd->hash_table, preventing the slab-out-of-bounds read in __cache_seq_start. Site 2 (cache_create_net) is where the cache is allocated and is unrelated to the missing check.

The fix adds noSTR to syntax flags after cmIF/cmELSE in the token reader, rejecting string literals in conditional-expression positions (e.g. '6-6?4:"",?4:"",?4:""') before the RPN stack becomes inconsistent and ParseCmdCodeBulk reads Stack[sidx] out of bounds. Site 2 is just a 'continue' in the same function, unrelated to the defect.

MSan use-of-uninitialized-value: the fix adds a bounds check (ip+cur < iend) in ZSTD_compressBlock_opt_generic to stop the read from reaching the uninitialised tail of the workspace buffer allocated at site 1; the crash manifests at the read in ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost (site 2).

The visible fix diff is entirely MIPS/Loongson build-system changes (arch.mk, cpu.cpp, targets.mk) with no change to decoder context lifetime; the actual UAF fix is presumably in the truncated portion of the diff, so causal cannot be confirmed.

Crash is a 1-byte OOB READ in mg_mqtt_parse (site 1); the fix (in a later hunk not shown in the truncated diff) adds a bounds check in the same function, so the missing validation (defect) and the crash are co-located at site 1. Site 2 is the same function in the amalgamated mongoose.c and is unrelated to the fix.

The loop condition 'next < end' only guarantees 1 byte, but the body reads next[0] and next[1] (2 bytes). The fix adds 'if ((end - next) < 2) return -1' before those reads, preventing the OOB read at line 687.

Fix rejects format-4 STAT axis values with minorVersion<2 (input validation) instead of continuing to parse and leaving fields uninitialised; the MSan crash is the later use of that uninitialised heap memory in WriteU16. Site 2 (ParseTable) is only the allocation origin, not the defect.

The fix adds an overflow guard (keyblock_offset > UINT32_MAX - keyblock_length) so that the bounds check blob.length < offset+length cannot be bypassed by a 32-bit wraparound; without it, a 32768-byte keyblock_length is used to read past a 150-byte buffer in mem_src_read.

The old check only tested (offset+size) > data_size, which passes for a negative or wrapping offset; the fix replaces it with GetRegion() that validates both bounds, preventing the 1-byte-before-buffer read in the memcpy.

abst_box_read reads a 'string' into an 8-byte tmp_str without verifying a null terminator exists; if the input lacks one, gf_strdup (strdup) reads past the buffer. The fix adds a zfound check that returns an error before the strdup call, preventing the OOB read.

The fix adds a check in load_function_section that the code entry is non-empty and ends with WASM_OP_END, rejecting malformed modules before they reach wasm_loader_prepare_bytecode where the 1-byte OOB read occurs.

SEGV at address 0 from calling NULL function pointer c->send_underlying; fix adds a NULL guard immediately before the call in send_callback, so the missing check (defect) and the crash are at the same site.

The old condition MqttIsPubRespPacket(packet_type)==MqttIsPubRespPacket(wait_type) matched when both were non-pub-resp, letting a wrong-type packet reach the decoder; the fix requires both to actually be pub-resp, stopping the OOB write at site 1.

The 'fix' diff only adds a regression test-case file (oss-fuzz-64465.html) with no code change, so no source weakness is addressed and no check would have stopped the OOB read of QSvgStyleSelector_nodeString.
Fix adds 'linelen > 0' guard before indexing line[linelen-1]; without it, linelen==0 makes the index -1, reading 1 byte before the realloc'd buffer (site 1). The missing validation lives at site 2.

After ignoring whitespace, tests, and build changes, the fix diff is empty (only a line-break reformat in pe.c and a test-data addition in BUILD.bazel), so the source weakness and causality cannot be determined; the UBSan index-out-of-bounds report does not specify READ or WRITE, giving sink 119.

CRL pointer freed at pkcs12.c:1745 but not nulled; second gnutls_x509_crl_deinit call at line 1791 dereferences the dangling pointer. Fix sets *crl=NULL after the first deinit so the second call sees NULL and returns early.

The fix in DecompressTIF adds a validation that the embedded TIFF's block size equals its raster size; without it, a mismatched block size causes ExpandPacked8ToByte1 to write past the 262144-byte destination buffer (heap-buffer-overflow WRITE).

The varint decoder reads a full 8-byte word (via get_unaligned_le64) that can extend up to 7 bytes past the bkey buffer; the fix allocates 8 extra bytes of padding in bch2_extent_update_i_size_sectors so the over-read stays in-bounds. Site 1 (__bch2_trans_kmalloc) is just the allocation helper and is unrelated to the defect.

The old binary search in FindNamedColor could increment/decrement indices past the end of gColorNames (e.g. the 'while ((int)gColorNames[lo]>=0) ++lo' loop); the fix restructures the search with rec_start and a hi==lo break to keep indices in bounds, preventing the OOB read at line 208.

xmlAllocOutputBuffer(encoder) at xsltutils.c:1886 internally frees the encoder via xmlCharEncCloseFunc (site 2, line 1928); the subsequent redundant xmlCharEncCloseFunc(encoder) at xsltutils.c:1888 then reads the freed memory (site 1, line 1920). The fix removes that redundant close call, eliminating the UAF read.

Fix changes ndpi_match_string_subprotocol to return NDPI_PROTOCOL_UNKNOWN instead of a negative error code on match failure; the negative value was stored as a protocol ID in ndpi_match_hostname_protocol (site 2) and later read as an uninitialised value in ndpi_detection_process_packet (site 1).
Fix rejects widths not divisible by 16 in vqc_decode_init, preventing the misaligned buffer that causes the OOB write in transform1.

MSan shows 'entropy' stack var in generate_hash_secret_salt is never initialised, stored via startParsing, then read in lookup (crash). The diff only contains a changelog entry; the actual code change (presumably initialising entropy) is not visible, so causal is unclear.

The closure's function_name string is freed (refcount→0) before the closure's free_storage releases it again; the fix adds the missing zend_string_addref in zend_create_closure_ex so the closure owns a reference, preventing the UAF read at zend_string_release.

MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value because explicit_bzero() is not instrumented; the fix swaps it for bzero() under MSan so the zeroing at site 1 is visible, preventing the read of the 'uninitialised' value at site 2.

The fix adds File#atime/ctime methods to mruby-io, which is unrelated to the GC use-after-free; the UAF is an internal GC incremental-phase bug where the sweep phase frees an object that the mark phase later reads, and adding Ruby-level File methods does not prevent that.

The fix adds a length validation (attr->hdr.length < 4) before reading buf[6]/buf[7] in decode_errcode_attr, preventing the 1-byte OOB read when the STUN error-code attribute is shorter than the 4-byte minimum. Both sites are the same function/line via different path spellings.

NewXMLTree prematurely frees attributes via DestroyXMLTreeAttributes at line 2311; the later DestroyXMLTree traversal reads the same freed attributes at line 449. The fix removes the early free, so the tree still owns attributes when DestroyXMLTree runs.

The original code indexed the VLC arrays as (total_zeros_vlc-1)[total_coeff], which yields index -1 when total_coeff is 0; the fix adds a zero-initialised slot at index 0 and shifts valid entries to 1..N, making the index always in bounds.

The fix tightens xlog_valid_rec_header to require the log version to match the superblock (v1 vs v2), rejecting a malformed record that would otherwise be misinterpreted and cause crc32c to read 8 bytes past the slab object. The crash site is crc32c_arch (site 2); site 1 (xlog_do_recovery_pass) is not on the crash path (which goes through xlog_find_tail).

The fix changes the loop variable from mrb_float to mrb_int so the iteration count deterministically matches the array capacity (mrb_int)(b-a)+1; with float accumulation (a+=1.0) the loop could run one extra time, writing past the 49200-byte buffer.

The fix validates that display width/height in the slice header match the dimensions used to allocate the frame buffer; without this check, a dimension change causes the format-conversion memcpy to write past the 3072-byte buffer.

KASAN reports a 1544-byte OOB READ in getname_kernel's memcpy (not at either listed site); the fix adds memchr-based null-termination validation for the user-supplied srcdev_name/tgtdev_name fields in btrfs_dev_replace_by_ioctl, which would reject the input before it reaches getname_kernel.
Fix adds bounds check on npx/npy before indexing into pixel data; without it, GET_DATA_BIT reads past the 288-byte buffer. Classic missing input validation → OOB read.

The fix adds a bounds check (dst <= endp) after adjusting endp for the embedded IPv4 size, preventing the write at line 333 from going out of bounds when a malformed IPv6 string (e.g. ':f:0:0:c:0:f:f:.') causes dst to underflow the 16-byte Address buffer.

Fix reorders the inner loop to check p+isize<q before dereferencing p[isize], and adds q-p>8 to the outer loop, preventing reads into the uninitialized tail of the realloc'd buffer. Site 2 (append_ape_tag_item) is merely where realloc created the buffer; the defect is the missing bounds check at site 1.

KASAN reports a slab-use-after-free WRITE in le_read_features_complete; the fix adds hci_conn_get/hci_conn_put reference counting in hci_le_read_remote_features to keep the connection alive until the async callback runs. Neither listed site (device_release, instrument_atomic_read_write) is the crash or defect location.

Double-free: init() at line 109 calls fini_deep() freeing the inner OpStr heap buffer, then the accelerator destructor at line 156 calls fini() again on the same buffer. The fix changes the default PreallocedCount from 8 to 2 in hb_vector_t, altering the vector's inline-storage layout to prevent the double-free; the defect lives in the vector template (hb-vector.hh), not at the listed site.

Both sites are the same location (card-openpgp.c:2786 in pgp_calculate_and_store_fingerprint). The fix adds a check that 20*key_id <= fpseq_blob->len before the memcpy, preventing the 20-byte write into a 2-byte buffer.

Fix validates dstCapacity (and maxDstSize) before use, preventing an undersized destination from propagating into FSE_writeNCount_generic where the 1-byte write lands 7 bytes past the 252811-byte heap buffer.

The struct declares oid as uint8_t[1] (site 1) but the code accesses it as a flexible array; UBSan flags index 2 as OOB for the 1-element type at site 2. The fix changes the declaration to a proper flexible array member oid[], resolving the type incompatibility.

MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value for 'ja3' stack buffer allocated in processClientServerHello (site 2); the fix reduces the loop bound in processCertificateElements (certificate_len-2) and adds a bounds check in extractRDNSequence, preventing the read of the uninitialized tail bytes that reach ndpi_is_printable_string (site 1).

Fix validates superblock-derived journal bucket counts (per-entry nr and total sum vs UINT_MAX) in bch2_sb_journal_v2_validate, preventing an undersized allocation that causes the OOB write in bch2_dev_journal_init.

The policy array ethnl_strset_get_policy was sized only up to ETHTOOL_A_STRSET_STRINGSETS, so indexing it with ETHTOOL_A_STRSET_COUNTS_ONLY caused a slab-out-of-bounds read in strset_parse_request. The fix extends the array to include the missing COUNTS_ONLY entry, completing the validation policy.

The closure function captured a pointer into active_glyphs_stack before calling push_cur_active_glyphs, which could reallocate the stack and leave the pointer dangling; the fix reorders to push first and then accesses the previous entry by index, eliminating the UAF.

MSan use-of-uninitialized-value: ReadPICTImage leaves pixel buffer regions uninitialised because ReadRectangle accepted negative/invalid coordinates; the fix adds a sign-bit and ordering check on the rectangle fields. The crash is the later read of that uninitialised pixel in ScaleQuantumToChar; DecodeImage is the PICT opcode dispatcher that calls ReadRectangle, so a validation there would also prevent the bad rectangle.

Fix corrects an off-by-one in the bit-position bounds check (size*8 → size*8-1) and adds a missing return so the check actually halts advancement; without it, bit_read_BB_noadv reads one byte past the 355-byte heap buffer.

The fix adds a *rsize >= 117 bounds check before indexing rdesc[115]/rdesc[116] in cougar_report_fixup; without it the function reads past the slab-allocated report descriptor. Site 2 (fortify-string.h) is unrelated kernel infrastructure.

The malloc in pcre2_compile_8 allocates a block whose size/layout did not account for char_lists_size, leaving bytes unwritten; the JIT's memcmp in detect_repeat then reads those uninitialized bytes. The fix corrects the block size calculation and code_start offset so all bytes are written before use.

The OOB READ at ihevcd_process is caused by a new SPS (same ID) carrying a different CTB size, so the worker thread indexes past the static buffer sized for the original SPS. The fix adds a CTB-size consistency check in the SPS parser (site 2) that rejects or resets before the mismatched parameters reach the processing thread.

The fix recomputes buff_diff after ndpi_serialize_csv_pre and passes it (instead of the fixed constant 'needed') as the size to ndpi_snprintf, preventing the write from exceeding the actual remaining buffer space.

The crash is a heap-use-after-free READ in bfd_getl16, caused by _bfd_dwarf2_slurp_debug_info freeing debug-info memory (via _bfd_dwarf2_cleanup_debug_info at dwarf2.c:4725) and then reading it later (dwarf2.c:4850). The fix only adds a missing free(matching) in the fuzzer harness error path (ada_addr2line.h), which is a memory-leak fix unrelated to the UAF in the BFD library, so it would not prevent this crash.

SEGV at pc=0x0 is a NULL function-pointer call during WASM compilation; the fix adds a bounds check (o->wasm >= o->wasmEnd) at the top of Compile_BlockStatements to reject malformed/truncated block code before the compiler dispatches a garbage opcode to a NULL handler.

Fix validates ms_ep->bLength against sizeof(*ms_ep) and the embedded jack count before the loop reads jack data, preventing the OOB read. Both the missing check and the crash are in snd_usbmidi_get_ms_info (site 2); usb_get_configuration (site 1) merely parses the raw USB config and is not where the fix lands.

The fix adds an is_std_info type-tag check in snd_usb_mixer_notify_id before casting a usb_mixer_elem_list to the larger usb_mixer_elem_info via container_of; without it, non-standard list elements (added by mixer_quirks) are misinterpreted, causing the slab-out-of-bounds write on info->cached.

The fix adds a size check on the APDU response in coolkey_get_cplc_data; without it a short/malformed response corrupts the CPLC structure, which later causes a double-free in coolkey_free_private_data during card disconnect.

MSan use-of-uninitialized-value from a heap allocation; the visible diff contains only trailing-whitespace edits in a docs file, so the actual code fix (and thus the exact source site and causal effect) is not determinable from the packet.

MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value; the fix moves initialization of use_low_freq_res into ixheaace_initialize_sbr_defaults so the field is always set before the frame-info generator reads it. Site 1 is merely the stack allocation origin, not where the missing write belongs.

The old bitmap_bytes() formula under-allocated the members bitmap; the fix replaces it with BITS_TO_LONGS(elements)*sizeof(unsigned long) and bitmap_zalloc, so the OOB read in test_bit (called from bitmap_ipmac_gc) is prevented. Site 2 (tomoyo) is unrelated.

The fix guards against unsigned underflow in opj_dwt_get_band_coordinates (tcx0 - (1U<<(nb-1))*x0b wraps to a huge value), which then drives an oversized memcpy in opj_dwt_decode_partial_tile, reading 17 GB past a 160-byte buffer.

The fix changes iterator dispatch in zend_implement_iterator so that classes overriding any Iterator method get zend_user_it_get_iterator instead of the SPL array's internal iterator, preventing the underlying array from being freed (via spl_array_set_array in __construct) while the foreach handler still holds a dangling reference to it.

The fix adds a minimum-length check (>=17 bytes) on the XMP profile before StringInfoToString is called, preventing the read of uninitialized bytes; both the missing validation and the resulting use-of-uninitialized-value occur in GetXMPProperty (site 2).
The fix rejects OJPEG-compressed TIFF files early in pixReadFromTiffStream, preventing the libjpeg-turbo decode path (null_convert) that stores the uninitialized value later consumed in putgreytile.

The x86_fpu slab cache was created with fpu_kernel_xstate_size (smaller than sizeof(struct fpu)=2432), so fpstate_init's memset of the full struct wrote past the slab object; the fix corrects the allocation size to sizeof(struct fpu).

The fix caps the file-derived entsize to sizeof(entry) before the r_buf_read_at call, preventing a write past the stack-allocated entry struct; the crash is the resulting stack-buffer-overflow WRITE in io_memory_read.

Fix in xmlTextReaderFreeProp removes the intSubset/extSubset guard around xmlIsID so xmlTextReaderRemoveID is always called, preventing a dangling ID reference after the node is freed by xmlTextReaderFreeNode; the UAF read then occurs in xmlXPathNodeSetAdd.

The fix rejects NaN decimal numbers in jvp_literal_number_new so they are never stored as literal numbers; without that check a NaN reaches decNumberCompare→decNaNs→decNumberCopy which writes past the 16-byte stack buffer 'res' in jvp_number_cmp.

Fix adds a transport refcount in maybe_initiate_ping (and matching unref in retry_initiate_ping_locked) so the transport is not freed while a pending timer callback still holds a pointer; the free at site 1 is correct given the (wrong) refcount, and the UAF READ at site 2 is the crash.

Fix clamps the producer index to 0 when it exceeds the ring size in __ptr_ring_swap_queue; the OOB read crash occurs in tun_net_xmit (consumer side), which is not among the listed sites, and neither listed site is where the missing check lives.

The PLY file specifies a property name not present in cloud_->fields; the original code only had an assert (compiled out in the fuzzer build) before dereferencing the iterator at rend(). The fix replaces the assert with a runtime check that returns early, preventing the OOB read of finder->datatype at line 126.

The fix removes a try/catch that swallowed an IOException from PentaxDecompressor::decompress, leaving the alignedMalloc'd buffer uninitialised; without the catch the exception propagates and checkMemIsInitialized is never reached. Site 1 (alignedMalloc) is merely the allocation origin, not the defect.

UAF: xmlXIncludeIncludeNode freed fallback children (and their shared namespace) after splicing included nodes into the tree, leaving a dangling ns pointer read later by xmlNodeDumpOutputInternal. The fix reorders the free before the splice and copies the fallback list, preventing the dangling reference. xmlFreeNs (site 1) is just the standard free in the call stack, not the defect site.

Fix zero-initializes the allocator struct in main so the jbig2 library uses default malloc/free instead of garbage function pointers; MSan reports a use-of-uninitialized-value at jbig2.c:359 following a free at :358, consistent with corrupted allocator state causing a premature free then access.

The post-switch code accesses ptr->sizes[i] after i has been incremented by 2 (case 4) or 1 (default), so on the last iteration i points past the end of the buffer. The fix moves the max_size/total_size/total_samples updates into the switch using a local s_size, eliminating the OOB read at the incremented index.

ConstrainCoordinate clamped coordinates to ±SSIZE_MAX, but the pixel cache buffer needs a 512-byte safety margin; the fix tightens the clamp to ±(SSIZE_MAX-512), preventing the negative-offset memcpy in GetVirtualPixelCacheNexus from writing before the buffer.
is_full_path reads path[1] without first checking the string is non-empty; the fix adds an early return when path[0] is NUL, preventing the 1-byte OOB read of the empty string literal at line 81.

The fix removes a SAX-activity condition that gated the buffer-size check and realloc in xmlParseCommentComplex's get_more path; without it the buffer was not grown before xmlCopyCharMultiByte wrote past its 4-byte allocation.

subset_find_guint8 returned an offset relative to the parent tvbuff instead of the subset, making the offset too large; the corrected (smaller) offset prevents the subsequent tvb_memcpy from writing past the stack buffer.

DrawImage allocates primitive_info via AcquireQuantumMemory but never initialises it; the fix adds ResetMagickMemory to zero the buffer. The missing write is in DrawImage, not in the allocator (site 2) or the reader (site 1).

The loop in IsValid() only checked entry < end, but GetEntrySize() reads sizeof(ChannelMaskEntryBase) bytes; the fix tightens the bound to entry + sizeof(ChannelMaskEntryBase) <= end, preventing the OOB read in GetEntrySize().

The fix moves device_init_wakeup and gpiod_put before usb_driver_release_interface so that data->oob_wake_irq, data->udev->dev, and data->reset_gpio are no longer read after the device is freed; release_nodes is the normal free path, not the defect.

The fix adds a missing 'return' after pj_default_destructor frees P; without it, execution continues and writes to the freed projection object. Neither listed site (caller pj_init_ctx, or the dealloc helper) is where the defect or crash occurs.

Integer overflow in v->n_sample * f->size at site 1 causes an undersized buffer allocation; the subsequent z->size * m pointer arithmetic at site 2 also overflows, producing a wild write address (0x151fc99845c8). The fix adds (size_t) casts and an INT_MAX cap to prevent both overflows.

The fix removes the warning-count limit in vips__new_output_message that called jpeg_abort, freeing the JPEG state while the pool-thread decoder was still writing into it; free_pool is just the generic deallocation mechanism, not the site of the premature-free decision.

Crash is a 2-byte OOB READ at Flow.cpp:6004 in dissectMDNS; the fix adds a bounds check (i+sizeof(rsp) >= payload_len) at line 6141 in the same function before a memcpy of the same size, validating the input-derived offset before use.

Crash is MSan use-of-uninitialized-value in SkArithmeticImageFilter (SkNx_cast read), but the fix adds an offset-overflow guard in SkDisplacementMapEffect::onFilterImage; the causal link (displacement map producing a partially-initialised bitmap later read by the arithmetic filter) is plausible but not directly visible in the stack.

Heap-use-after-free READ in MqttDecode_Vbi; the fix adds XMEMSET of client->msg in MqttClient_WaitMessage to clear stale pointers to freed rx-buffer memory, and refactors props freeing into Handle_Props. The free at site 2 is in fuzzer test code (vector destructor), not a library defect.
alpn_str is stack-allocated in processClientServerHello without initialization; the fix adds alpn_str[0]='\0' before the parse loop, preventing the uninitialized read in ndpi_strdup/strlen.

The UAF occurs because zend_std_write_property calls zend_verify_property_type, which triggers __toString() that frees the object via refcount, then continues to use the freed pointer at line 719. The fix only changes zend_atoi to ZEND_ATOL in env/INI parsing, which is unrelated to this object-lifecycle bug.

Fix adds memset(buf,0,count*size) in Read() when fread returns a short count, zeroing the unfilled portion of the malloc'd buffer; the malloc at site 2 is the origin of the uninitialised memory but the missing write is in Read().

MSan use-of-uninitialized-value in jxl_u32 reading padding bytes of a packet buffer; fix memsets the AV_INPUT_BUFFER_PADDING_SIZE after memcpy in ff_combine_frame, so the missing initialisation (CWE-456) is in that function, not at the realloc origin (site 2).

The fix moves hlist_del_init and super_wake(SB_DEAD) before put_super in deactivate_locked_super, so the superblock is removed from the global list and marked dead before its last reference can free it, preventing concurrent sget_fc walkers from reading freed memory in fuse_test_super/get_fuse_conn_super.

Crash is an OOB WRITE in setup_engineID (not a listed site); the fix adds a length>=4 validation in oldengineID_conf (site 2) so a too-short EngineID is never stored, preventing the undersized allocation that causes the 4-byte write to overflow.

MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value in xmlDetectEBCDIC reading the 'out' buffer; the fix adds null-termination (out[outlen]=0) and reserves a byte for it, so the missing initialization (source 456) and the crash (sink 457) are both in xmlDetectEBCDIC (site 1). Site 2 (xmlSwitchEncoding) is where MSan attributes the stack allocation of 'out', but the allocation itself is not the defect.

UBSan reports index 2 OOB for DGNPoint[2] without specifying read/write direction, so sink is 119. The fix adds a per-iteration byte-offset bounds check against nElemBytes (input validation, CWE-20) in the same function; site 2 is where that validation logic lives, site 1 is the failing access.
The same function frees ar in the default: case (line 1399) then reads ar->type at line 1403; the fix adds !valid to short-circuit the ar->type access when ar was freed, preventing the UAF read.

GetVariadicCount cast a potentially negative int64_t to size_t without validation; the resulting huge count made resize allocate a tiny buffer (wraparound), so the subsequent loop writing to buffers[i+2] overflowed. The fix rejects counts < 0 or > INT32_MAX before the cast.

Fix diff is empty, so the exact source site and causal effect cannot be confirmed; the crash is a MemorySanitizer use-of-uninitialized-value at HorizontalFilter (site 2), with the uninitialised value originating from a heap allocation and stored via ReadCachePixels (neither a listed site).
Fix validates len against the actual chunk size before the memcpy in H5O__cache_chk_serialize; without it, a 64-byte read overflows the 8-byte chunk buffer allocated during deserialization.

The fix isolates the namespace database for entity parsing (xmlCtxtParseContent) so entities don't share the parent's ns; without this, xmlFreeNs frees a namespace still referenced by the node, and xmlStaticCopyNode reads the freed ns (UAF READ).

The fix adds rc=SEPOL_ERR in cil_resolve_classorder (not a listed site) so an unresolvable class name aborts before the classorder reaches the fixed-size binary buffer; site 1 (cil_resolve_classcommon) is a sibling error-propagation fix in the same commit but on a different resolution path.

The memcpy at line 126 reads dsize bytes from buf+dofs without checking that dofs+dsize fits within buf_size; the fix adds exactly that bounds check at line 137, preventing the 256-byte read on a 255-byte buffer.

The VM stack is allocated via mrb_malloc in stack_init (vm.c:119) but never zeroed; the fix replaces the Ruby Kernel#p with a C implementation that avoids the VM opcode path (mrb_ary_new_capa → GC → mark_context_stack) that reads the uninitialised stack bytes.

The fix adds an overflow guard on width*height before the new[] allocation in ParseTextureColorData; without it the product wraps, the buffer is undersized, and a later texel comparison reads past the end.

Crash is a 4-byte OOB READ at the DLT_NULL memcpy (site 1); the fix adds a caplen < sizeof(u_int32_t) guard immediately before that read (site 2), which would have rejected the 1-byte packet before the out-of-bounds access.

Fix adds a mutex around the per-CPU template refcount in nft_ct.c to prevent a race between alloc and free; the crash (UAF write in nft_ct_tmpl_put_pcpu) and the defect (missing lock in nft_ct_set_init/__nft_ct_set_destroy) are both in nft_ct.c, which is not among the listed sites.

The stack-allocated decNumber res in jvp_number_cmp lacks sufficient unit storage for a NaN with a large payload; the fix enlarges the buffer by embedding decNumberUnit space, preventing the OOB write in decNumberCopy.

UBSan flags a member call on a zero-sized AK::Array<T,0> (GNU zero-length array extension makes the struct too small); the fix replaces T[0] with a proper EmptyArrayStorage<T> type so the object has sufficient size.

The header validator at site 2 only checked arealen > sectionlength, ignoring the offset_size+exten_size header overhead; the fix adds the combined-size check, rejecting the crafted input before read_single_rle_entry (site 1) reads past the 68-byte buffer.

MSan use-of-uninitialized-value: buffer allocated via malloc in parseSonyMakernotes (sony.cpp:1628) is read uninitialized in process_Sony_0x9050 (sony.cpp:618). Fix replaces malloc with calloc / vector(n) with vector(n,0) at call sites; site 1 is just a pass-through malloc wrapper, not the defect.

The fix adds a column-index bounds check (col + left_margin < raw_width) to the if-condition guarding the rawdata read; without it the 2-byte read at line 122 runs past the 2996-byte buffer allocated in unpack().

OOB READ of 64 bytes from segment->data (wasm binary) in memcpy inside InitDataSegments; the fix adds input-validation guards (segmentOffset>0 bounds restructure in m3_env.c plus parse/compile hardening) that stop the malformed data segment from reaching the memcpy.

The fix changes inode_bmap to return a proper status (1/0/-errno) with etype as an out-param, and adds explicit err<0 / err<=0 checks at every call site; the old int8_t return conflated extent type with error, letting callers proceed on invalid extent data that caused the slab OOB read in udf_get_filelongad. Site 2 (skbuff.c) is unrelated to UDF.
The fix removes std::min clamping in the LJpeg decodeN loop that left parts of the allocated buffer unwritten; MSan then flags the uninitialized bytes when checkRowIsInitialized reads them.

The fix replaces manual realloc-based char**/UINT32* arrays with wArrayList, eliminating the undersized buffer allocation; the crash is a 17-byte memcpy into a 12-byte heap buffer allocated in the same function (line 916 vs 924).

UAF read of mgmt_pending_cmd in mgmt_remove_adv_monitor_complete; fix changes ownership from shared pending list (mgmt_pending_add/remove) to caller-owned (mgmt_pending_new/free) so the cmd pointer cannot be freed by another path before the sync callback runs.
